programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Zona's Awesome Fishing Show
programme.desc: The unpredictable nature of fishing is why the sport is, well, awesome. That's the opinion of former professional angler Mark Zona, who demonstrates on his Outdoor Channel show the allure of not knowing what's going to happen with each cast. Episodes might start with a targeted species, but that's where the scripts end. What happens after that -- the successes and the failures, the magic and the miseries, the ecstasies and the agonies -- keep viewers guessing on what the next bite may bring. Zona's TV career began in 2005 as the co-host of "Loudmouth Bass." He has also provided analysis on Bassmaster tournament telecasts.

programme.desc: Jackie hunts Montgomery Properties Ranch in Texas then hunts his home state of Alabama.

programme.title: Addicted to the Outdoors
programme.desc: Join Jon and Gina Brunson as they take a look back at their entire 20+ year career, they've taken 26 seasons of Addicted and cut each season into 1 episode, to bring you 26 episodes encompassing their entire career.

programme.title: Realtree Outdoors
programme.desc: Cole Barthel hunts Louisiana and David Blanton hunts Mississippi during the opening weekend of turkey season.

programme.title: Wild Upland
programme.desc: Host Kali Parmley hunts her home state of Utah with the Riddle family-legends in the bird dog world.

programme.title: Shooting USA
programme.desc: It's a new shooting sport format designed for the entry level competitor, with levels to challenge even the best practical shooters. The NRA is rolling out their new format for the competition with Americas Rifle, the AR-15.

programme.title: American Rifleman TV
programme.desc: NRA World Shoot, HK CC9, British Brown Bess.

programme.title: The Next Bite
programme.desc: Tommy Kemos and Justin Schneider drag jigs at the mouth of the river for Lake Winnebago walleyes.

programme.title: Lake Commandos
programme.desc: Mark Courts and Chad Koel discuss the future of Lake Commandos while catching trophy largemouth bass.

programme.title: Facts of Fishing
programme.desc: Bait packages don't always give you all the information... sometimes it pays to get creative.

programme.title: In Fisherman TV
programme.sub-title: Into the Wilderness for Fine Fishing
programme.desc: The In-Fisherman staff reveals world-class wilderness fishing venues, as they take you into the wilderness close to home for small stream catfish; explore the benefits of private-water fishing for giant bluegills, and travel to the Yukon River in Alaska, the best destination in North America for some of the world's largest northern pike.

programme.title: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat and his pal Jason Stanhope meet up outside of Charleston for a day of quail hunting and grilling birds over live coals.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners
programme.desc: Chef and the crew travel up river to look for ducks and spend time at a historical hunting camp.

programme.title: American Bird Hunter
programme.desc: Two young labs work hard on waterfowl hunts in Saskatchewan.

programme.title: The One
programme.desc: A lion ravages the camp and a nearby village as Mike Stroff and his dad seek to hunt some of the most dangerous game on the continent of Africa.

programme.title: Backwoods Life
programme.desc: Michael and Beth Lee are north of the border with friends from 1776 Ammo; lots of ducks and geese are in the area and the team is in for a great hunt.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Shock Therapy
programme.sub-title: Jims Top Guide - 2025 Yukon Recap - Part 1
programme.desc: Jim sits down with his lead guide, Kristian Anderson Davies, to relive the triumphs, challenges, close calls, and unforgettable moments from Rogue River Outfitters' 2025 Yukon season.

programme.title: Hooked on Africa
programme.desc: The saying goes that all good things come to an end. However on this trip home from the big blue off Madagascar, the open waters provided a number of species willing to get the reels screaming and adrenaline spiking...

programme.title: Reel Africa
programme.desc: The African Tiger Fish has a well-earned reputation as the ultimate freshwater game fish, lightning quick, agile, powerful, and deadly, which makes it the ideal candidate to lure with Live Bait.

programme.title: Tracks Across Africa
programme.desc: Julius Fortuna and friends start an epic two-episode safari in Zimbabwe's famed Matetsi unit with plenty of dangerous and plains game on their safari wish list. And the action comes fast!

programme.title: Beyond the Hunt
programme.desc: Rick chases bugling bulls in the Nebraska Sandhills.

programme.title: Eastman's Hunting TV
programme.desc: Todd Helms and Scott Reekers go on an exhilarating antelope hunting journey in Wyoming, where they showcase stunning landscapes and their expertise in nature; adrenaline and strategic moments of tracking antelope, as they redefine the art of hunting.

programme.title: Buckventures
programme.desc: Jeff Danker finds himself in central Oklahoma chasing a big buck named 6X; after an offseason preparing for this buck, Jeff comes face to face with him on opening day.

programme.title: Heartland Bowhunter

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Live: MLB Tonight
programme.desc: Featuring live look-ins, updates, highlights, reporting, interviews and analysis by MLB Network's experts.

programme.title: Live: MLB Tonight
programme.desc: When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster that includes former players Eric Byrnes, Al Leiter, Dan Plesac, Billy Ripken and Mike Lowell, and inside information men Tom Verducci, Jon Heyman, Peter Gammons and Ken Rosenthal. Greg Amsinger, Brian Kenny and Matt Vasgersian are among the hosts.

programme.title: Live: Quick Pitch
programme.desc: Sometimes, fans of America's national pastime might miss a day or two of their favorite sport due to pesky things like work, a wedding anniversary, or a child's high-school graduation ceremony. Rest easy, devotees of the diamond -- MLB Network has you covered. "Quick Pitch" not only provides complete highlights of each game from the previous day, but also presents a glimpse at upcoming contests, including pitching matchups.

Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Live: MLB Tonight
programme.desc: Featuring live look-ins, updates, highlights, reporting, interviews and analysis by MLB Network's experts.

"Quick Pitch" not only provides complete highlights of each game from the previous day, but also presents a glimpse at upcoming contests, including pitching matchups.

programme.title: Siegfried & Roy: The Original Tiger Kings
programme.desc: At the height of their fame, groundbreaking magicians Siegfried & Roy were the highest-paid entertainers in Las Vegas history, globally renowned for blending magic with their astonishing killer-cat interactions. Millions of tickets were sold, billions of dollars were made, and tiger mania swept the nation. But life in the ultra-exotic world of Siegfried & Roy may not have always been what it seemed, as the magicians lived by the art of illusion off stage as well-painstakingly crafting myths about their relationships with their tigers and even with each other. Then after building that empire based on smoke, mirrors and giant cats, Siegfried & Roy's longstanding world of illusions was destroyed by one fateful onstage encounter with an angry tiger in front of a sold-out audience. That horrifying act of violence shocked the world, unleashed a torrent of wild conspiracy theories, and forever redefined the magicians' legacy.

programme.desc: This pioneering documentary film depicts the lives of the indigenous Inuit people of Canada's northern Quebec region. Although the production contains some fictional elements, it vividly shows how its resourceful subjects survive in such a harsh climate, revealing how they construct their igloo homes and find food by hunting and fishing. The film also captures the beautiful, if unforgiving, frozen landscape of the Great White North, far removed from conventional civilization.

programme.title: The Toy Wife
programme.desc: Gilberte "Frou Frou" Brigard (Luise Rainer) is a flirtatious 16-year-old girl with formidable charm and beauty that fascinate most men. Although she has her pick of potential husbands, Frou Frou chooses George Sartoris (Melvyn Douglas), the fiancé of her sister Louise (Barbara O'Neil). Frou Frou and George soon marry, but the life of a wife and mother does not suit the immature Frou Frou. Before long, Louise is brought in to run the house, and Frou Frou is beginning an affair.

programme.title: Mills Blue Rhythm Band

programme.title: Intruder in the Dust
programme.desc: Lucas Beauchamp (Juano Hernandez) is a strong, proud African-American man accused of murder in small-town Mississippi in the 1940s. As the town's white residents prepare to lynch him, a teenage boy named Chick (Claude Jarman Jr.) whom Beauchamp had once saved from drowning becomes convinced of the man's innocence, and races to discover the real murderer before it's too late. This film, adapted from William Faulkner's 1948 novel, was made on location in his hometown of Oxford, Mississippi.

programme.title: The Romance of Rosy Ridge
programme.desc: In the divided state of Missouri after the Civil War, allegiances to the North and South separate many communities. When Southerner Gill MacBean (Thomas Mitchell) welcomes a stranger, Henry Carson (Van Johnson), into his home in Rosy Ridge, Gill is suspicious of Henry's loyalties. As Henry earns the family's trust -- and falls in love with Gill's daughter, Lissy Anne (Janet Leigh) -- he convinces the residents of Rosy Ridge to overcome their prejudices.

programme.title: Stars in My Crown
programme.desc: Man of God Josiah Gray (Joel McCrea) is determined to bring religion to the people of Walesburg, a dusty southern town still healing from the Civil War. Though initially Josiah must hold his parishioners at gunpoint, in time he wins over the community and marries his organist, Harriet (Ellen Drew). As the years pass, a number of situations arise, including a typhoid outbreak and a hostile mob, in which Josiah must prove that God is the only force that can restore peace in Walesburg.

programme.title: Highway 301
programme.desc: A network of armed robbers successfully gets away with several million dollars before the law can stop them.

programme.title: The Phenix City Story
programme.desc: Based on a sensational news story, this film looks at the murder of Albert L. Patterson (John McIntire), who hopes to win the an attorney general's job in Alabama. Phenix City is a dangerous place to run for election without the backing of local gangsters, but urged on by his ex-military son, John (Richard Kiley), Albert promises to restore law and order to the crime-ridden city. Though he pays the ultimate price for his bravery, his candidacy inspires residents to stand up to the mobsters.

programme.title: Reflections in a Golden Eye
programme.desc: An Army major (Marlon Brando) with a lusty wife (Elizabeth Taylor) feels homosexual in the 1940s South.

programme.title: Don't Make Waves
programme.desc: New Yorker Carlo Cofield (Tony Curtis) goes on a vacation to Southern California, where he quickly becomes immersed in the easy-going local culture while getting entangled in two beachside romances. First, he makes the acquaintance of the lovely Laura (Claudia Cardinale), who seems to like him but is also involved with the laid-back Rod (Robert Webber). Next, Carlo falls for the free-spirited Malibu (Sharon Tate) -- but he has a tough decision to make when Laura starts to pursue him.

programme.title: A Fine Pair
programme.desc: A New York police captain (Rock Hudson) helps an Italian beauty (Claudia Cardinale) return some stolen jewels to a safe in Austria.

programme.title: West Point
programme.desc: Wealthy football player Brice Wayne enters West Point and, though he does well on the football field, angers his fellow cadets. He resigns, only to return for the big game and reunite with Betty Channing, the hotel owner's daughter.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Air
programme.desc: Two-fisted shipping pilot Brass Bancroft (Ronald Reagan) is tapped by Secret Service agent Tom Saxby (John Litel) to infiltrate an air freight company that's smuggling illegal aliens over the Mexican border in its planes. Ensnaring lead smuggler Jim Cameron (James Stephenson) in a plot to purchase some counterfeiting plates, Bancroft finds himself endangered when his straight-arrow friend, Gabby Watters (Eddie Foy Jr.), blunders into the operation, unaware that Bancroft is working undercover.

programme.title: Murder in the Air
programme.desc: Secret Service agents Brass Bancroft (Ronald Reagan) and Gabby Watters (Eddie Foy Jr.) believe they have uncovered an enemy agent: a homeless man found dead in a train crash, who had $50,000 in cash and incriminating tattoos. With this lead, Brass takes the dead man's place to find out what his ultimate goal was. It turns out that the man had ties to terrorists whose intent is to destroy a dirigible, the "Mason," which is transporting a potentially game-changing weapon for the U.S. Navy.

programme.title: Secret Enemies
programme.desc: After the death of a close friend who worked as a secret agent, Carl Becker (Craig Stevens) is spurred to leave his law practice and girlfriend (Faye Emerson) behind to avenge the death of his lost confidante. Becker goes deep undercover to hunt out a dangerous nest of Nazis led by the notorious Dr. Woodford. However, this daring American finds more than he bargained for when he discovers his duplicitous lady love is in league with America's enemies.

programme.title: Born for Trouble
programme.desc: A reporter (Van Johnson) and his colleagues (Faye Emerson, George Meeker) work together to solve the murder of a death-row inmate.

programme.title: The Hidden Hand
programme.desc: The authorities apprehend an escaped mental patient turned serial killer.

programme.title: Private Detective
programme.desc: A female private eye joins forces with a police detective to investigate the suspicious murder of a millionaire.

programme.title: The Last Ride
programme.desc: Brothers on opposite sides of the law clash over a stolen goods ring and their love for the same woman.

programme.title: Truck Busters
programme.desc: A driver leads independent truckers against big-time mob-supported operators who try to run them out of business.

programme.title: Escape From Crime
programme.desc: Red O'Hara (Richard Travis) serves a prison sentence after being framed by Dude Merrill (Paul Fix). Once he's released, he seeks out a job as a news photographer. Although papers are hesitant to hire an ex-convict, he catches a break when he's at the scene of a bank robbery and snaps some pictures. He's hired by Cornell (Frank Wilcox) and begins specializing in crime-scene photos. When he gets wind of a job Merrill is planning to pull, he sees his big chance for both revenge and respectability.

programme.title: Dark Victory
programme.desc: Socialite Judith Traherne (Bette Davis) lives a lavish but emotionally empty life. Riding horses is one of her few joys, and her stable master (Humphrey Bogart) is secretly in love with her. Told she has a brain tumor by her doctor, Frederick Steele (George Brent), Judith becomes distraught. After she decides to have surgery to remove the tumor, Judith realizes she is in love with Dr. Steele, but more troubling medical news may sabotage her new relationship, and her second chance at life.

programme.title: 'Til We Meet Again
programme.desc: Time is short for Joan Ames (Merle Oberon). Suffering from a terminal illness, she has only weeks to live and has decided to spend her remaining days traveling the globe. While on a cruise ship back to America, she meets and falls in love with Dan Hardesty (George Brent). Joan doesn't want to ruin their romance by telling him the truth about her illness, but what Joan doesn't know is that Dan's time is limited too; he's a convicted criminal being sent back to America to face his execution.

programme.title: Honeymoon for Three
programme.desc: On a book tour stop in Ohio, author Kenneth Bixby (George Brent) is surprised when a young woman, Julie Wilson, attaches herself to him, insisting that they were once college sweethearts. Julie's concerned cousin approaches Ken's devoted secretary and fiancée, Anne Rogers (Ann Sheridan), to enlist her aid in dissuading Julie from pestering Ken. Ken believes Julie is harmless, but is taken aback when her husband, Harvey (Charlie Ruggles), arrives and encourages him to run off with Julie.

programme.title: Experiment Perilous
programme.desc: When psychiatrist Hunt Bailey (George Brent) encounters elderly Clarissa "Cissie" Bedereaux (Olive Blakeney) during a violent storm in 1903, his unusual relationship with the strange Bedereaux family begins. Suspicious of Cissie's sudden death and bewitched by a painting he sees of Allida (Hedy Lamarr), the gorgeous but troubled wife of Nick Bedereaux (Paul Lukas), Hunt sets out to discover if Allida is really insane, as her husband claims -- or if Nick is the disturbed one.

programme.title: You Can't Escape Forever
programme.desc: A demoted reporter (George Brent) and his girlfriend (Brenda Marshall) seek to expose a crime kingpin.

programme.title: Swingtime in the Movies
programme.desc: A director working on a musical falls for a local waitress working in a canteen.

programme.title: Montana Belle
programme.desc: Belle Starr (Jane Russell), a voluptuous outlaw, is lying low in a small desert town with Bob Dalton (Scott Brady) and his feckless bank robber brothers. When wealthy saloon keeper Tom Bradfield (George Brent) takes a liking to her, Belle reassesses her options and considers playing the men against each another. Knowing that Tom wants to get Bob out of the picture, she leads one suitor on a crime spree against the other while puzzling through her complicated romances.

programme.title: The Gay Sisters
programme.desc: Orphaned by the death of their father in World War I, three wealthy sisters -- Fiona (Barbara Stanwyck), Evelyn (Geraldine Fitzgerald) and Susanna (Nancy Coleman) -- band together to defend their ownership of the family property. But as their riches dwindle, Susanna marries a real estate developer (George Brent) so that she can qualify for a separate family inheritance. However, she soon learns that her hubby is only after her property, and she eventually squares off against him in court.

programme.title: Gold Is Where You Find It
programme.desc: Mining expert Jared Whitney (George Brent) is courting Serena (Olivia de Havilland), but her father, farmer Col. Ferris (Claude Rains), views Jared as a symbol of the new mining techniques that damage the land and disapproves of him. As Jared goes to work for a devious mining company run by rival members of the Ferris family, Serena begins to sour on him. But when Jared learns that his employer's recklessness led to a man's death, he sees why the elder Ferris resists some new mining companies.

programme.title: The Old Maid
programme.desc: After disappearing for two years, Clem Spender (George Brent) returns on the day his former fiancée, Delia (Miriam Hopkins), is marrying another man. Her cousin Charlotte (Bette Davis) sneaks away with Clem, who enlists in the Union Army the next day and dies soon after. Charlotte and Clem's child, Clementina, grows up not knowing critical Charlotte is her mother. Jealous of Charlotte's affair, Delia pretends to be Clementina's mother, sabotaging mother and child's relationship.

programme.title: Jezebel
programme.desc: In one of her most renowned roles, Bette Davis portrays Julie Marsden, a spoiled Southern belle who risks losing her suitor with her impetuous behavior. Engaged to successful banker Preston Dillard (Henry Fonda), Julie pushes him away with her arrogant and contrary ways, leading to a scandalous scene at a major social event and his subsequent departure. When Preston eventually returns and Julie attempts to win him back, she discovers that it may be too late.

programme.title: The Great Lie
programme.desc: After her long-time boyfriend, pilot Pete Van Allen (George Brent), marries fiery concert pianist Sandra Kovak (Mary Astor) while drunk, Maggie Patterson (Bette Davis) is heartbroken. Pete learns the marriage is illegal, yet dutifully offers to remarry Sandra. But when she refuses to alter a performance date to do so, Pete returns to Maggie and marries her. Soon after, Pete goes missing on a flight -- and when Maggie learns Sandra is carrying Pete's baby, she makes the pianist a shocking offer.

programme.title: In This Our Life
programme.desc: In this melodrama, pampered sibling Stanley Timberlake (Bette Davis) is 24 hours away from marrying her lawyer fiancé, Craig Fleming (George Brent), when she absconds with Dr. Peter Kingsmill (Dennis Morgan), the husband of her sister Roy Timberlake (Olivia de Havilland). To clear the way for her sister's marriage to Peter, Roy quickly divorces him, but then starts seeing her sister's former fiancé, Craig. Stanley's true nature begins to reveal itself, forcing Peter to look for a way out.

programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.
